name: functions
description: The seed of dist/apps/functions/package.json: Nx's generatePackageJson starts from this file and adds every package the source imports. It lists only what the source never imports but the deployed package must hold: Cloud Build installs the upload with pnpm (the pruned pnpm-lock.yaml beside it) and then requires the Functions Framework to be a declared dependency. Not a pnpm workspace package (pnpm-workspace.yaml excludes it); the version is the root package.json's.
